a.xlink:title: Stops following and recenters the orbit camera on the map center.
Draws one frame from the given state.
Finds the tile under a screen point by projecting every tile and taking the nearest one.
Updates the hovered tile in the state from the current cursor position (3D mode).
Applies an incantation message to the state.
Draws the terrain and ground resources.
Draws the ground and the entities for the frame.
Selects the entity standing on a tile (preferring players), or clears the selection.
Moves one resource unit between a player's inventory and its ground tile.
Polls input and updates the camera and selection.
Resolves the entity currently followed, auto-detaching if it is gone or not a player.
Picks the entity under a 3D click by casting a ray onto the ground.
Picks the entity under a 2D (top-down) click and updates the selection.
Handles a pdr message: the player drops one resource onto its tile.
Handles a pgt message: the player picks one resource up from its tile.
Applies a Trantorian message to the state.
